_comment: Rules for the non-hook threads. `format`, `sound` and `cadence` are computed arithmetically in build-index.mjs and are exact; the rules here cover the two that need pattern matching. The @-tag patterns and the handle conventions are derived from the app ledger and the handles themselves at index time, not written here. Every match records the phrase that produced it.

insertion._note: Four mechanics were identified across the five networks. A post can carry more than one.

rules.label: Hashtag + on-screen text
rules.note: Vent Now's mechanic: the app is named inside the spoken/overlaid line and again as a hashtag. No disclosure, no link, no tag.

rules.label: Brand name in the caption
rules.note: The app is named in prose in the caption body, outside the hashtag block.

rules.label: @-tag as collaborator credit
rules.note: The brand account is tagged in the caption, which reads as a collaborator credit rather than an ad. Patterns are the app names in the ledger.

rules.label: Comment-keyword CTA
rules.note: 'comment Roamy if you want me to send you the app'. Buys comment volume and moves the link off-platform into DMs.

rules.label: Discount / affiliate code
rules.note: Potto's @demi_does.it carries 'use c0de DEMI' — affiliate, not organic.

disclosure._note: Disclosure phrases in captions and bios. Absence is as load-bearing as presence — the tag `none` is real.

rules.label: Declared in bio
rules.note: Vent Now personas carry 'partner of vent now' in the bio rather than on the post.

handleConvention._note: Derived at index time: a suffix after the last dot shared by two or more handles in one app is a convention. `brand-shaped` is the fallback for an app's own account.

sound._note: Computed, not matched: a sound is `original` when its title is the platform's auto-generated original-sound label in any language, otherwise `licensed`. `brand-original` is an original sound belonging to one of the brand's own handles.
